mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
